cmd:
set -e
git config --global user.name "weather-odessa-vps"
git config --global user.email "vps-bot@weather-odessa.local"
echo ===VERIFY===
git config --global --get user.name
git config --global --get user.email
echo ===TEST-COMMIT===
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
git fetch origin main --depth 1 --update-shallow
git checkout -B main origin/main
echo test > /tmp/_git_identity_test.txt
cp /tmp/_git_identity_test.txt data/_git_identity_test.txt 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f data/_git_identity_test.txt
git status --short
